name: Evaluation
summary:
It is time for your Evalua†ion.

Evaluation is an emulation of an old program that was distributed amongst the Church in the early to mid nineties.

The program was used to evaluate Faith, Self-worth and to Commune with spirits. It was taken out of circulation and banned by the Vatican outright in 1999.

While every attempt has been made to emulate this program exactly, there are some flaws and the program may not respond correctly.

Songs of Praise, a tape of Worship music that was originally included with a purchase of the program, has been transferred to digital and included with the program.
